test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The North–South corridor, which is a part of the Golden Quadrilateral super highways, links which two cities of India from the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Srinagar and Kanyakumari**____.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The North-South corridor of the** golden quadrilateral is 4,000 kilometers** in length and connects Srinagar to Kanyakumari/Kochi.

 
 
• National Highways 44 is associated with the North-South corridor
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The East-West corridor of the Golden Quadrilateral connects Silchar and Porbandar cities in India.
 
• The North-South–East-West Corridor is the largest highway project(ongoing) in India.
 
 
• The project is managed by the National highways authority of India(NHAI).
 
• The project consists of building 7300 kilometers of four/six-lane expressways connecting Indian cities like Srinagar, Kanyakumari, Kochi, Porbandar, and Silchar.
 
 
 
• The East-West corridor of the golden quadrilateral is 3,300 kilometers in length and connecting Silchar and Porbandar.
 
 
• National Highways 27 is associated with the East-West corridor.
 
 
 
• Silchar is a city in Assam.
 
• Porbandar is a city in Gujarat.
